title: 💭 AI thought process

Well, as a large language model, I don't think in the traditional sense. My "thought process" is more of an algorithmic procedure. When you ask a question or provide a prompt, it's passed through layers of neural networks, each layer composed of thousands of interconnected nodes. These nodes perform simple mathematical operations on the input, and the results are passed along to the next layer.
